div.head: I Cn 16
div.ab: And þæt man ælc beboden fæsten healde, si hit ymbrenfæsten, si hit lengctenfæsten, si hit elles oðer fæstæn, mid ealre geornfulnesse.
Be fæstene. Þæt man ælc beboden fæsten healde, sy hit ymbrenfæsten, sy hit lenctenfæsten, sy elles oðer fæsten, mid ealra geor[n]fulnysse.
And þæt man ælc bebodan festen healde, sy hit ymbrenfæsten, sy hit le[n]ctenfesten, sy hit ælles oððer festen, mid ealre geornfulnesse.
Omne indictum ieiunium deuote conseruetur, siue quatuortemporale siue quadragesimale uel deinceps aliud quodcumque sit.

Legitima etiam ieiunia et uigilię sanctorum, sanctę Marię scilicet et omnium apostolorum, excepto Philippi et Iacobi propter pascalia festa, et ieiunia omnium sextarum feriarum, nisi sit festiuitas, teneantur.

[16] Edicimus etiam, ut omne indictum ieiunium siue quadragesimale siue legitimum siue uigiliarum, id est omnis festi apostolorum, preter festum Philippi et Iacobi, quod precedente ieiunio Resurrectionis gratia caret, siue omnis diei Ueneris, nisi festum sit, summopere conseruetur.
Be fæstene. Þæt man ælc beboden fæsten healde, sy hit ymbrenfæsten, sy hit lenctenfæsten, sy elles oðer fæsten, mid ealr[e] geor[n]fulnysse.
And þæt man ælc beboden fæsten healde, si hit ymbrenfæsten, si hit lengctenfæsten, si hit elles oðer fæstæn, mid ealre geornfulnesse.
(Vom Fasten B) Und dass man jedes gebotene Fasten mit aller Bereitwilligkeit halte, sei es Quatemberfasten, sei es Frühlingsfasten, sei es sonst anderes Fasten.
(Of fasting, B) And that every commanded fast be kept with all eagerness, whether it be an Ember fast or a Lenten fast or any other fast.
Concerning fasts. And every prescribed fast shall be observed with all diligence, whether it be the fast of the Ember Days, or the Lent fast, or any other fast.

And each ordained fast is to be observed with all assiduousness, whether it is the Ember Fast, the Lenten fast, or any other fast. And a fast is to be observed on all of the feasts of Saint Mary as well as on the feasts of each of the apostles—but we order no fast for the Feasts of Philip and James because of Easter—

div.note: B's rubrics are always in red. Liebermann compares II Eg 5.1; VI Atr 23, 22.3.; Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 297, October 2026 (MS Cons); AV: corrected against Rabin p. 244, October 2026 (was “∅”, now “And a fast is to be observed on all of the feasts of Saint Mary as well as on the feasts of each of the apostles—but we order no fast for the Feasts of Philip and James because of Easter—”); AZ: corrected against Rabin p. 244, October 2026 (was “∅”, now “|”)
Ember Fast: See note to 5 Æthelred 18.
Feasts of Philip and James: May 3 and April 30 (now more frequently celebrated on July 25), respectively.

Cf. II Edg. 5, 1; VI Atr. 22, 3; 23; Procl. of 1020, cap. 19; II Cn. 46.
